name: Panther Cage Key
summary: At Whitereach Post, Wizlo Bearingshiner guards the Panther Cage Key. It opens the cage left among the wrecked wagons of an ambushed caravan in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Precarious Lock
sections.body: Wizlo Bearingshiner is a goblin tinker who barely escaped a centaur attack on his caravan north of Whitereach Post. The raiders ransacked the wagons and cargo, yet left a sturdy cage untouched. A rare, ferocious panther waits inside. Around its neck hangs Wizlo’s prized invention, a hypercapacitor gizmo. The snarling beast kept the centaur at a distance, and only Wizlo’s key can open the cage and recover the device.

faq.q: Who provides the Panther Cage Key?
aliases: where to get panther cage key
faq.answer: Wizlo Bearingshiner, a goblin tinker resting at Whitereach Post in northwestern Thousand Needles, provides the key.
The key opens an iron cage among the broken wagons of a ruined caravan just north of Whitereach Post. An enraged, dangerous panther is inside.

faq.q: Why didn't the centaur loot the cage?
faq.answer: The centaur ransacked the rest of the caravan but left the cage alone. The captive panther was too ferocious and threatening to approach.

faq.q: What is inside the cage besides the beast?
faq.answer: Wizlo’s prized hypercapacitor gizmo hangs around the panther’s neck. To recover it, someone must unlock the cage and face the predator.

angles.text: The key opens a cage holding a tinker's volatile prototype. Wizlo has left his delicate invention in a dangerous place.
Helping Wizlo can make the roads around Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles safer after centaur raids.
